No complete current AICTE approval export was successfully accessed; AICTE approval should be separately cross-checked before operational use.
TG EAPCET 2026 Institute Profile page returned an administrative security error when opened directly; 2025/2026 portal was not used as the sole verification universe.
District mapping follows source wording and current familiar names; legacy JNTUH labels (Medak, Nalgonda, Mahabubnagar, Ranga Reddy, Warangal Urban/Rural) are preserved rather than silently recast.

Underrepresented or absent districts in this source set include Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Mulugu, Narayanpet, Vikarabad, and Jagtial; absence is not evidence that no engineering institution exists there.
The OU PDF is a course list, not a current admissions roster; Swathi entry is M.E/M.Tech-only and flagged.
